description: This source file defines the implementation of a component object for the BSP Run-time Execution Engine (BREE). It includes functions for creating, initializing, and removing a 'Reader' object that is part of the BREE system, along with associated member functions. The code is object-oriented in style, simulated using C structures and function pointers.
